cross_capture_contract.full_names_compared: Full normalized BALLOT NAME strings locally, never first/last fragments or normalized-party classes alone.
cross_capture_contract.actions_cell_expected: View Details; compare as observed UI text, exclude from candidate output, never invoke details.
cross_capture_contract.row_uniqueness: Five unique full ballot-name strings within each capture, no partial-name dedupe across offices; exact ordered tuple equality across all3captures.
cross_capture_contract.retain_raw_DOM_and_raw_date: Original byte-pinned capture preserved; output stores source name/date/label literals locally, plus parsed dates with explicit format.
cross_capture_contract.filing_date_format: %m/%d/%Y; all five known dates in February2026 and not later than observed November3 capture date.

proposed_typed_record_schema.source_party_label: Exact source label, not legal party/adoption inference

proposed_typed_record_schema.date_filed_iso: Parsed ISO date, no conflation with certification/publication/capture date
proposed_typed_record_schema.source_locations: All3capture IDs and one-based data-row locators retained locally

acceptance_criteria: Future helper reads only5 exact artifacts; no network, browser, hidden API, details or filesystem writes.
Exact JSON/schema/URL/clock/bytes/hashes, table/header/9columns, filters/status/pagination and five ordered full tuples independently checked.
First capture checkbox-state and all captures name-input-state omissions remain explicit, not backfilled.
Four Approved and one Withdrawn records retained; no approvedD fabricated; blank district/writein preserved; no printed/writeinbool forced.
Authored fixtures use names prefixed DEMO and synthetic IDs; real names/contacts never leave local ignored inputs/outputs.
Admitted hash/parser/runtime/cancel failures must not yield partial successful candidate/report artifacts; future persistence only seals exception type and static code, not raw values.
Prior readers/configs/base admission remain unchanged; original source role/rights/asof/latest/final/geography/selection gates stay separate.
negative_test_plan: Missing/extra/corrupt input, source digest drift, wrong approved contract digest, symlink/parent-symlink/path traversal and source mutation during parse.
Duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite values, unsupported top/data keysets, malformed UTC clocks and reordered clocks.
Wrong URL/capturekind, source header/role substitution, official link mismatch, primary/general/date/title mismatch.
Missing/duplicate/reordered tables/header/rows/cells; wrong9columns, unknown header chrome or class tokens, nested table/contact content in candidate span.
Wrong selected party/district/office/election/page-size, dropped/unchecked/extra federal/Senator status checkbox, initial omission silently treated as checked.
Wrong totals/ranges, truncated50/15/5tables, duplicate/missing Senate row or missing next-office boundary in mixed captures.
Crosscapture full-name/party/status/date/district/writein/actions mismatch, same-initial/different-full-name cases and coordinated resealing of mutable capture files against immutableapproved pins.
Invalid/future date, Approved-to-Withdrawn swap, unknownparty/status, nonblank district/writein, non-Federal Senate row and stateSenator contamination.
Private name/contact sentinel in public diagnostics/error messages/bundles, unsupported printed/writeinboolean coercion.
KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit/parser failure at first/middle/last input and after tuple extraction before result return; no partial successful artifact/output.
open_methods_questions: Is the five-artifact record with explicit missing name-input state sufficient for source-local bounded extraction only? Proposal says yes for observed tuples, no for unfiltered/global/upstream completeness.

Can future readiness admit OBSERVED_GENERAL_CONTEXT_CANDIDACY_STATUS_HISTORY records and typed unknown ballot/writein status in a separately versioned route? No change proposed to acceptedbaseadmission now.
